title: Reflect hero
description: A centred night-sky opening: pill badge, a 72px gradient-filled heading, a muted lead, a violet and a dark button and a line of small print; below, a glowing horizon with two hairline orbit rings (with square beads) that turn slowly in opposite directions inside a turning starfield, and the app window rising out of it in a double hairline frame that fades away at the bottom, with a round glass play button that swells on hover. On phones the heading wraps to two lines, the buttons stack and the window becomes a tall phone-shaped crop.
notes: backdrop (16:9 light effect, a looping video in the original) and screen (1198×748 desktop, 350×658 phone) are media slots; empty, they are a glow wash and a muted panel
designed for a dark theme: on light themes the glow reads as a soft lilac wash
rings and stars are CSS loops and stop under reduced motion
name: reflect-hero
